apps.name: Audio Report AI
apps.subtitle: Private, local transcription and report drafting
apps.localizedDescription: Record or import audio, transcribe it locally with Whisper, and generate structured reports using the bundled LFM3 model. No cloud processing, accounts or runtime networking. All processing happens on your device.

versions.localizedDescription: First public release. Includes Whisper large-v3-turbo for transcription and LFM3-1.7B for report drafting.
